content.question: How does RMSProp adjust learning rates?
options: It uses one global learning rate that decays at the same speed for all parameters.
It gives each parameter its own learning rate based on the exponential moving average of its squared gradients.
It sets every learning rate equal to the inverse Hessian of the loss.
It alternates between large and small learning rates at random.
content.answer: It gives each parameter its own learning rate based on the exponential moving average of its squared gradients.
